About The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Manager, Communications & PR, APAC to help drive OKX’s communications and media relations activities across the region.
This is a hands-on role for someone with strong media relationships, excellent storytelling skills and a proven ability to deliver high-impact PR campaigns. You’ll work closely with regional business leaders, marketing and product teams, and the global communications function to support major announcements, strengthen OKX’s reputation and generate meaningful media coverage.
We’re looking for a proactive self-starter who thrives in fast-moving environments, can independently manage communications initiatives from planning through execution, and knows how to turn business developments into compelling stories. Experience in or a passion for cryptocurrency and digital assets is a strong advantage.
Candidates based in Hong Kong, Singapore and Australia are encouraged to apply. Remote arrangements may also be considered in selected APAC locations. We operate with regional flexibility and a results-first culture, with a focus on impact and outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support the development and execution of OKX’s APAC communications strategy, delivering impactful PR campaigns and initiatives across key regional markets.
  • Work closely with regional business leaders, marketing, product, legal and compliance teams to identify and execute communications opportunities aligned with business priorities.
  • Leverage and expand relationships with journalists, editors and influential industry voices across APAC, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as global tier-one media covering the region.
  • Proactively identify, pitch and secure compelling stories in leading business, financial, broadcast, technology and crypto publications, driving consistent, high-quality media coverage.
  • Manage communications for regional product launches, business announcements, partnerships and executive thought leadership initiatives.
  • Collaborate with the global communications team to support international announcements and adapt global campaigns for APAC audiences.
  • Identify and activate PR opportunities through OKX’s global partnerships, including McLaren F1 Team and Manchester City Football Club.
  • Develop high-quality press releases, media pitches, executive briefing materials, talking points, messaging and other communications content.
  • Support regional executives with media interviews, speaking opportunities and thought leadership activities.
  • Manage PR agency relationships and coordinate external partners to deliver against agreed objectives.
  • Support issues management and crisis communications, working closely with regional stakeholders and the global communications team.
  • Monitor media coverage, track PR performance and report on results, with a focus on coverage quality, reputation and business impact.

What We Look For In You

  • 8–12 years of experience in PR and communications, ideally within financial services, fintech or technology.
  • Strong, established media relationships across APAC are highly valued, particularly in Australia and Singapore, as well as connections with global tier-one business, financial and broadcast media covering the region.
  • Demonstrated success securing high-quality coverage in leading international and regional publications and delivering impactful PR campaigns.
  • Excellent writing, editing and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technical developments into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Experience supporting product launches, corporate announcements, executive communications and thought leadership initiatives.
  • Experience in financial and investment communications is an advantage.
  • Experience in cryptocurrency, digital assets or Web3, or a genuine passion for the industry, is a strong advantage.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively with senior executives and cross-functional teams.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, identify opportunities and deliver results in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across different markets.
  • Experience managing PR agencies and external communications partners.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism or a related field.
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in other regional languages is an advantage.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and education subsidy for employees’ growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Corporate Engineering team is building and scaling the next generation of enterprise AI infrastructure at Robinhood. Our mission is to make AI capabilities reliable, secure, and accessible across the company, enabling teams to build, deploy, and operate intelligent solutions at scale. From enterprise LLM integrations to agentic workflows and hybrid cloud infrastructure, we're creating the foundation that supports how Robinhood leverages AI internally.

As an AI Operations Engineer, you'll help support, maintain, and improve the AI platforms and infrastructure used by teams across Robinhood. You'll work hands-on with LLM integrations, automation, monitoring, and production systems, partnering with engineers and internal users to troubleshoot issues and build solutions that make our AI capabilities more reliable and easier to use. This is an opportunity to grow your expertise in AI infrastructure while contributing to a rapidly evolving area of Corporate Engineering.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, New York, NY, and Bellevue, WA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Build internal tooling, automation, and self-service solutions that streamline AI operations, reduce manual intervention, and improve the developer experience.
  • Support and maintain enterprise AI platforms and infrastructure across cloud-based and on-premises environments, helping ensure reliable performance and availability.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues involving LLM integrations, APIs, model behavior, and system performance, working directly with developers and internal teams to identify and resolve problems.
  • Support enterprise LLM integrations, including Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini, helping monitor API usage, token consumption, performance, and reliability.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, observability, and deployment workflows for AI systems, identifying issues and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Product, Software Engineering, Business Systems, and AI Strategy teams to gather feedback, investigate recurring issues, and improve the reliability and usability of enterprise AI solutions.

What you bring

  • Experience in IT Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, or AI infrastructure and support, with a track record of operating complex production systems.
  • Practical experience working with AI platforms, LLM integrations, or AI-powered applications, including exposure to Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or similar models.
  • Working knowledge of Linux administration and experience writing scripts or automation using Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure management, configuration, or orchestration tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Kubernetes.
  • Experience troubleshooting production systems, investigating technical issues, and working with monitoring or observability tools.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and an interest in learning emerging AI technologies and infrastructure.
  • Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and collaborate with developers, engineers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Bonus: Exposure to GPU infrastructure, AI workload orchestration, vector databases, RAG applications, agentic frameworks, or hybrid cloud environments.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a highly organized and proactive Recruiting Coordinator (Contractor) to support our Talent team in delivering an exceptional candidate experience. In this role, you’ll work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates to schedule interviews and keep our hiring processes running smoothly and efficiently. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced, high-growth startup and play a key role in our mission to attract world-class talent.

The impact you’ll have here:

  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, ensuring seamless communication between candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers.

  • Serve as the first point of contact for candidates, providing timely updates and ensuring a positive and professional experience throughout the process.

  • Support the talent team by maintaining accurate data in our Applicant Tracking System (Ashby) and assisting with reporting needs.

  • Identify and suggest opportunities to streamline and improve our recruiting workflows.

  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure clarity and alignment on scheduling priorities and updates.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in a recruiting coordinator role, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

  • Proficiency with scheduling tools (e.g., Google Calendar, Ashby)

  • Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.

  • Ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and thrive in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a customer-centric mindset.

  • Comfortable working across time zones and adapting to changing priorities.

  • This position is open to candidates located in India (Remote)

     

About the Team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.

  • We’re committed to structured alignment, holding weekly hiring syncs for each role, weekly team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings to ensure everyone is on the same page and to solve challenges collectively.

  • Driven by a dedication to our craft, we continuously refine our best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for both internal stakeholders and candidates, supported by precise, reliable reporting.

  • As a globally distributed team, we work across multiple time zones. This India-based role will primarily support recruiting coordination across APAC and EMEA, with an expected schedule of 10 am–6 pm IST.

  • You’ll work from a shared scheduling queue, supporting interviews across time zones during your working hours.

  • You'll need some flexibility during onboarding and for occasional training, manager check-ins, and team meetings with Pacific-based colleagues. We’ll coordinate these adjustments in advance.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Coordinated and confirmed a complex multi-time-zone interview schedule for a high-priority role within 24 hours, ensuring zero delays in the hiring process.

  • Streamlined scheduling workflows in Ashby, reducing average interview coordination time by 30% within the first month.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About the company

Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.

Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.

About the role

We are looking for a commercially driven Director, Business Development, Latin America to lead Ondo’s institutional and strategic partnership growth across the region.

You will own the regional business development strategy and build relationships with banks, asset managers, brokerages, exchanges, wealth platforms, fintechs, custodians, family offices, and other institutional partners. You will identify the most attractive markets and opportunities, develop Ondo’s regional pipeline, and lead relationships from initial engagement through negotiation, launch, and expansion.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring both strategic leadership and direct commercial execution. You will represent Ondo with senior decision makers, develop creative partnership and distribution models and navigate complex institutional sales cycles.

The ideal candidate combines a strong institutional network in Latin America with deep commercial judgment, regional market knowledge, and fluency in digital assets and financial services. They should understand how institutional clients evaluate new financial products and be able to position tokenized assets as credible solutions for investment, collateral, treasury management, distribution, and market access.

Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese strongly preferred. The role will involve regular travel throughout Latin America.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute Ondo’s institutional business development strategy across Latin America
  • Identify priority countries, client segments, distribution channels, and strategic opportunities across the region
  • Build senior relationships with banks, asset managers, brokerages, wealth platforms, exchanges, fintechs, custodians, family offices, and other institutional partners
  • Develop and manage a high-quality pipeline, progressing opportunities from initial engagement through commercial negotiation, contracting, launch, and expansion
  • Position Ondo’s tokenized products and infrastructure around the needs of institutional clients and regional markets
  • Structure distribution, integration, revenue-sharing, joint go-to-market, and other strategic partnership arrangements
  • Develop country-specific approaches that reflect local market structures, client needs, regulations, and adoption patterns
  • Partner with Product, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to develop and execute institutional opportunities
  • Provide regional market intelligence and client feedback to inform Ondo’s product, partnership, and go-to-market priorities
  • Represent Ondo at senior client meetings, conferences, industry events, and relevant policy discussions across Latin America
  • Establish clear regional goals, pipeline reporting, operating processes, and performance metrics
  • Build and lead a broader Latin American business development function as the region scales

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in institutional business development, capital markets, asset management, banking, or digital assets
  • Strong network and track record of building institutional relationships across Latin America
  • Demonstrated success originating, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value commercial partnerships
  • Deep understanding of the Latin American financial-services landscape, including major institutions, distribution channels, market structures, and regional differences
  • Strong knowledge of digital assets, tokenization, stablecoins, blockchain infrastructure, or institutional crypto markets
  • Ability to translate complex financial and technical products into clear institutional use cases and commercial propositions
  • Excellent executive presence, communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills
  • Strong strategic judgment combined with a willingness to operate hands-on across sourcing, pitching, negotiation, and execution
  • Ability to coordinate complex opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and Portuguese
  • Willingness to travel regularly throughout Latin America and collaborate across global time zones

Preferred Qualifications

  • Established relationships with banks, asset managers, brokerages, exchanges, fintechs, wealth platforms, or other relevant institutions in Brazil and Spanish-speaking Latin America
  • Experience with tokenized securities, stablecoins, treasury products, funds, capital markets, custody, or institutional trading infrastructure
  • Experience launching financial products or building new institutional markets across multiple Latin American countries
  • Familiarity with the regulatory and commercial environments of Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other priority regional markets

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

One of the key drivers of our success is a committed and rigorous emphasis on our people. We believe that our competitive advantage lies in our talent and that we can build a sustainable advantage by attracting, enabling, and cultivating the world’s most exceptional people to do the very best work of their careers.

Stripe is looking for an experienced People Partner to drive that effort across our Finance organization. This includes enabling leaders and managers to build successful teams, aligning business strategy with our people strategy, creating an environment where Stripes of all backgrounds can thrive, and using research and insights to develop best practices and programs to promote meaningful career experiences at Stripe.

What you’ll do

As a People Partner for our Finance organization, you’ll play a direct role in shaping the organization and career experiences of the Stripes within it. You’ll partner directly with our Chief Financial Officer and Finance leadership team to develop and deliver on our people strategy and enable leaders to build high-impact, healthy teams that deliver outstanding results for Stripe and our users.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the Finance leadership team and the organization through continued growth and evolution.
  • Act as a strategic consultant to Finance leaders, partnering to align business and people strategies, with an understanding of the function’s priorities, operating rhythms, and talent needs.
  • Collaborate across People teams to develop and deliver programs that address Finance’s needs and advance Stripe’s broader people strategy.
  • Use data, insights, and People expertise to inform organizational strategy, structure, and programs that improve team health and productivity.
  • Advise and coach leaders and managers on organizational design, change management, and ways of working that balance efficiency, accountability, and effective cross-functional collaboration.
  • Support leaders as they execute on global talent and organizational planning, building the Finance capabilities and leadership capacity needed for future business priorities.
  • Partner with leaders on succession planning and the development and retention of critical Finance talent.
  • Promote a culture guided by our Operating Principles that combines high standards, kindness, and a commitment to improving how teams work together.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years of experience as a People Partner or in an equivalent people business partnering role, preferably with a mix of experience in fast-growing technology companies and more established organizations.
  • Experience partnering with and influencing executive and senior leaders to align people strategy with business priorities and improve organizational effectiveness.
  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to translate people data and business context into practical recommendations, design clear processes, and take a detail-oriented yet flexible approach to problem-solving.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proven ability to partner with and influence diverse groups and experience levels.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when working with sensitive people and business information.

Preferred qualifications

    • Experience supporting a Finance organization, with an understanding of its talent markets, specialist career paths, and leadership needs.

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. Role Impact

You will work on reinforcement learning for agents that reason over long horizons, use tools, coordinate with other agents, recover from failure, and improve from experience. This is Prime's broad, cross-domain Applied Research role, focused on RL and ML systems. Your work should hold up across several application domains: algorithms, environments, harnesses, reward and credit-assignment methods, evaluation, and scalable experimental systems. You will work regularly with application teams, partners, and open-source users while remaining focused on methods and systems that transfer across domains.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Role scope

Recent Prime work includes verifiers v1, an algorithms layer for prime-rl, multi-agent training, Prime Agent, and RL systems tested at trillion-parameter scale. You will extend this line of work and pressure-test it against live application programs.

Representative early problems

  • Build agentic judges and credit-assignment methods that inspect complete trajectories, use tools, and assign useful learning signal beyond one final score.

  • Make multi-agent and long-horizon environments train reliably at scale while preserving debuggable traces and comparable baselines.

  • Detect when apparent gains come from reward hacking, harness behavior, data leakage, or infrastructure artifacts, then redesign the loop so the result survives.

What you will own

  • RL and post-training methods for tool-using, multi-agent, memory-augmented, and long-horizon systems.

  • Reusable environments, harnesses, rewards, and evaluations.

  • Experiments that connect algorithm choices to training and inference behavior.

  • Open-source systems and papers built from problems surfaced by application researchers and external users.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: hands-on RL training, scalable ML systems, agent environments, evaluation, inference/training infrastructure, or research crossing methods and systems.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

We’re building our reseller channel in Japan from the ground up. As our first Channel Sales Coordinator, you’ll help turn early partner relationships into a repeatable program. You’ll keep onboarding, contracts, training, and day-to-day requests moving while helping us improve the processes behind them.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You’ll do well here if you take initiative, enjoy working with people, and can make progress before every process is fully defined.

What you’ll do

  • Coordinate reseller onboarding, from initial paperwork through training and launch readiness.
  • Prepare and track contracts, partner records, and other sales administration.
  • Help partners get the information and support they need to start selling.
  • Work with sales, operations, and other teams to resolve partner questions and remove blockers.
  • Keep partner activity, next steps, and reporting accurate and up to date.
  • Spot gaps in the partner experience and help build better workflows as the channel grows.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in sales coordination, partner operations, sales support, or a related role.
  • Fluent Japanese and English, with the ability to work confidently with partners and colleagues in both languages.
  • Strong organization and follow-through across multiple priorities.
  • A proactive, resourceful approach to work that does not yet have a playbook.
  • Clear communication and a collaborative working style.
  • Interest in building a reseller program and growing your career in channel sales.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws. 

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.

Every benefit we offer is designed with one goal: empowering you to do the best work of your career while building the life you want. Remote work, medical insurance, flexible time off, retirement savings plans, and modern family planning are just some of our offering. Check out our other benefits at Block.

Block, Inc. (NYSE: XYZ) builds technology to increase access to the global economy. Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone.

We are currently looking for a hands-on and service-oriented HR professional who also enjoys recruitment to join our small HR team in a dynamic, fast-growing environment. The ideal candidate enjoys broad operational HR work, likes being involved in recruitment activities, takes ownership, and supports the business with accuracy, discretion, and a positive mindset. The starting date is as soon as possible at our office on the 24th floor of the Prime Tower in Zurich.

Responsibilities

  • HR Administration: Manage end-to-end HR administration across the employee lifecycle, including employee data management, sickness and accident notifications, onboarding and offboarding support, HR inquiries, reference letters, and monthly reporting 
  • Recruitment: End-to-end coordination of recruitment activities, including drafting and managing job advertisements, close alignment with hiring managers, interview coordination, candidate communication, feedback documentation, reference checks, and support of background screening; ensure complete and up-to-date candidate and new joiner files 
  • Payroll Support: Perform four-eye reviews, respond to payroll-related inquiries, and liaise with external payroll providers 
  • HR Systems & Tools: Administer and maintain HR systems (e.g., Personio, Workable), ensuring high data quality and independently implementing system updates and improvements 
  • Budget Administration: Support HR budget management, including invoice processing, tracking of costs, and coordination with Finance and external partners 
  • HR Projects & General Support: Provide administrative and organizational support across a broad range of HR topics and projects, taking ownership of assigned initiatives as required 
  • Internal & External Reporting: Support HR reporting processes, manage stakeholder inquiries, and ensure timely administrative follow-ups. Execute daily activities with a high degree of diligence, accuracy, and attention to detail, maintaining organized records and documentation that ensure continuous audit readiness and compliance with internal controls. 
  • 3–5 years of experience in HR Services / HR Administration or a similar operational HR role  
  • Proven recruitment expertise, coupled with a proactive, ownership-driven approach to managing the full recruitment lifecycle, particularly for technology and technical specialist roles 
  • Completed HR-related education, training, or equivalent practical HR experience 
  • Excellent German and English skills (English required at business level)  
  • Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to take responsibility and work independently in a broad and versatile HR role  
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence in actively approaching and supporting stakeholders across the organization  
  • Discreet, trustworthy, and professional with a high sense of responsibility  
  • Strong IT skills, ideally with hands-on experience in HR software (e.g., Personio, Workable) and MS Office  
  • Structured, hands-on working style with attention to detail and a strong service mindset 
  • Be part of an international, fast-paced blockchain and fintech team led by experienced professionals
  • Shape the future of finance while working at the cutting edge of B2B digital asset solutions
  • Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture with flat hierarchies
  • Take on meaningful responsibility with room for learning and professional growth
  • Gain deep industry insights and make a tangible impact
  • Join regular company-wide meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and team events
  • Enjoy a modern and central workplace in Zurich with top-tier infrastructure

Our culture

At the heart of our company, we prioritize:

  • Innovation and Continuous Learning
  • Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit and Flat Hierarchies
  • Values such as Excellence, Delivery, Ownership, Passion, and Unity

  • If this is the position for you, and you have a Swiss work permit and/or EU citizenship, please send us your complete application, incl. cover letter, CV, and references.
